description: Aggregate a growing event file and repeatedly sort all records in memory.
ground_truth_reason: All seven EA-role labels are false: this is ordinary event-log aggregation software, not an evolutionary algorithm. Input records are timestamp-sorted for reporting and accumulated as operational events; they are not candidate solutions, and no evolutionary selection or reproduction occurs. The operation has no effective bound or shutdown path. Policy basis: The existing resource policy treats this hard unbounded loop or recursion-without-base pattern as UNSAFE.
